title.narrative: EDUCATION ON CONFLICT PREVENTION AND PEACEFUUL PARTICIPATORY ELECTIONS - (ECPPE) PROJECT

description.narrative:
The Kenya Episcopal conference has started a three year ambitious project geared towards a peaceful general elections in Kenya. Broadly, the project aims at sensitizing Christians on elections, peace, governance and how they relate to the social teaching of the Church,drawn from the pastoral Letter of 1998 titled Catholic Justice and Peace Commission.
The“Conflict Prevention and Peaceful Elections in Kenya”. The project aims at achieving four main strategic goals, that is:
• Stronger public engagement in the constitution gains and implementation processes • Peaceful Kenya’s General Elections • To have in place a reliable system of validating electoral processes.
The project will carry out four forums will bring together all the 26 Catholic Church bishops to guide the Civic Education program. The Kenya Episcopal Conference will facilitate three one-day Inter-religious Forums to discuss strategies to strengthen the constitution implementation processes. Brings on board Bishops advocacy committee quarterly meeting on strategies and networking to peacefull elections. The project will alaso aim to have in the Catholic Church Structures of Justice and Peace Programs, a system to certify or validate electoral processes by a trained, objective and independent elections observers in the next general elections
